'''2017 Worlds Day 2 Ming Huo DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ming Huo]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ming Huo]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
